column1: This fall in the total amount of trade is the reason economists usually oppose protectionist policies. International trade benefits all countries by allowing each country to specialize in what it produces best and by providing each country with a greater variety of goods and services. Protectionist policies diminish these gains from trade. Although these policies benefit certain groups within society— for example, a ban on imported cars helps domestic car producers—society on average is worse off when policies reduce the amount of international trade.
